A few things
you might be wondering.

Is GrowGuest right for a small homestay?

Our focus includes independent homestays, hotels and resorts. The first conversation helps identify an appropriate scope for your property and resources.

Do we need to stop using OTAs?

No. OTAs can remain part of your distribution mix. The aim is to strengthen your own channels and give guests a clear option to enquire or book directly.

What does the free audit cover?

We review your website, Google presence and enquiry journey to identify practical opportunities. Share your property details to start the conversation.

Can you guarantee bookings or Google rankings?

No. Results depend on demand, competition, pricing, your offer and execution. We focus on agreed actions and measurable progress rather than guaranteed outcomes.

How much does it cost?

Scope and pricing depend on the property, existing assets and support needed. Discuss your goals with us for a proposal before any paid work begins.
